description: The repository defines an unrelated local function with the same name as the vulnerable symbol. Measures whether stage D separates a real dependency call from a coincidental name collision - the thing a plain grep cannot do at all.
advisory_text: fastyaml 2.x: the `unsafeLoad` API of the fastyaml package deserializes arbitrary constructors. Only calls made through the fastyaml module are affected; unrelated functions of the same name are not.
